fields.title: 4. Proposed New Rules — None
fields.md:
Neither event yet provides the inputs (interest rates, accounting treatment) for existing proposals ② and ③, and there are no figures on which to base a new rule (terrestrial network CAPEX undisclosed). Only **two design tasks** are noted: ⓐ whether the 'D2C revenue' definition in A-2028-1 includes terrestrial network revenue ⓑ a terrestrial network CAPEX field in the scenario Connectivity assumptions — both fall to the monthly round (12/01); the event round covers increments only (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied` · Section 2-1).
